Requirement: Authors and reviewers need to generate and use reports without network access.
Name: Proposed offline workflow need

Requirement: The generator shall convert one requirements CSV snapshot into a single interactive HTML report.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid CSV, one `.html` file is produced and displays every input row.

Requirement: The generator shall compare an old and new requirements CSV and produce a single interactive HTML diff report.
Acceptance Criteria: The report classifies matched and unmatched requirements and displays both snapshots' content.

Requirement: The generator and generated report shall operate without network access.
Acceptance Criteria: Snapshot, diff, review, save-copy, and filtering workflows succeed with networking disabled.

Requirement: The generator shall produce a report from a local requirements CSV while networking is disabled.
Acceptance Criteria: With networking disabled, the generator produces a self-contained HTML report from a local CSV.
Name: Proposed generator offline requirement
Rationale: Covers offline report generation as a separately verifiable part of the end-to-end workflow.

Requirement: The browser report shall open a generated local HTML report and support review and saving a report copy while networking is disabled.
Acceptance Criteria: With networking disabled, a reviewer opens a local HTML report, filters a requirement, and saves and reopens a report copy.
Name: Proposed browser offline requirement
Rationale: Covers offline use of the generated report as a separately verifiable part of the end-to-end workflow.

Requirement: The report shall contain its CSS, JavaScript, data, and comments in one HTML file.
Acceptance Criteria: The report contains no external stylesheet, script, font, image, CDN, or data dependency.

Requirement: The report shall not edit requirement field values.
Acceptance Criteria: No UI control changes the source requirement values; only comments are editable.

Requirement: The application shall not execute arbitrary user templates, raw HTML, or scriptable Markdown.
Acceptance Criteria: Malicious CSV and configuration fixtures render as inert content.

Requirement: Snapshot mode shall accept a positional CSV input and a required output path.
Acceptance Criteria: `reqtable INPUT.csv -o OUTPUT.html` succeeds when the ID column is configured.

Requirement: Diff mode shall accept `--old`, `--new`, and a required output path.
Acceptance Criteria: `reqtable --old OLD.csv --new NEW.csv -o OUTPUT.html` succeeds.

Requirement: Snapshot input and diff inputs shall be mutually exclusive.
Acceptance Criteria: Combining a positional input with `--old` or `--new` exits with code 2 and an actionable message.

Requirement: Diff mode shall require both old and new CSV paths.
Acceptance Criteria: Supplying only one diff path exits with code 2.

Requirement: Comment extraction mode shall accept a commented HTML report and output CSV path.
Acceptance Criteria: `--extract-comments REPORT.html -o OUTPUT.csv` creates a valid CSV.

Requirement: Comment extraction mode shall not be combinable with CSV generation inputs.
Acceptance Criteria: Conflicting inputs exit with code 2.

Requirement: The CLI shall support JSON configuration plus explicit command-line overrides.
Acceptance Criteria: A CLI value replaces the corresponding JSON value while unrelated JSON values remain active.

Requirement: The CLI shall provide `--help`, `--version`, and `--print-default-config`.
Acceptance Criteria: Each option exits successfully and produces the expected text or valid JSON.

Requirement: Configuration precedence shall be CLI, then JSON, then built-in defaults.
Acceptance Criteria: A three-level precedence fixture resolves each setting from the highest supplied level.

Requirement: The application shall not discover configuration files implicitly.
Acceptance Criteria: A config file in the working directory has no effect unless passed with `--config`.

Requirement: The configuration root shall be a UTF-8 JSON object.
Acceptance Criteria: Non-object roots, malformed JSON, and unreadable files produce configuration errors.

Requirement: Unknown configuration keys shall be rejected.
Acceptance Criteria: A misspelled key exits with code 2 and names the unknown key.

Requirement: Configuration shall support CSV encoding, delimiter, and strict-column settings.
Acceptance Criteria: Each setting changes CSV parsing as documented.

Requirement: Configuration shall support initial hidden columns and explicit column ordering.
Acceptance Criteria: The generated report opens with configured visibility and order.

Requirement: Configuration shall support display labels and validated CSS widths by original column name.
Acceptance Criteria: Labels render without changing matching keys; unsafe widths are rejected.

Requirement: Configuration shall support limiting Markdown rendering to named columns.
Acceptance Criteria: Listed columns render Markdown and unlisted columns preserve text safely.

Requirement: Configuration shall support initial diff view and changes-only state.
Acceptance Criteria: The report opens in the configured view with the configured status set.

Requirement: Configuration shall support ignored diff columns and optional trailing-whitespace normalization.
Acceptance Criteria: Ignored columns do not change row status; enabled normalization ignores trailing whitespace only.

Requirement: Configuration shall support comment enablement, initial reviewer initials, CSV column name, and CSV comment format.
Acceptance Criteria: Each comment setting appears in report or extraction behavior.

Requirement: All CSV columns shall be included unless configuration hides them.
Acceptance Criteria: An unconfigured column appears in the column chooser and table.

Requirement: Configured column order shall place named columns first and retain CSV order for the remainder.
Acceptance Criteria: A partially ordered schema appears in the expected order.

Requirement: Diff schema shall be new headers followed by old-only headers.
Acceptance Criteria: A schema-change fixture produces the specified union ordering.

Requirement: CSV shall be parsed with standard quoting, escaped quotes, delimiters, and multiline fields.
Acceptance Criteria: RFC 4180-style fixtures preserve decoded values and line breaks.

Requirement: The first CSV record shall define the headers.
Acceptance Criteria: Data records map to the first record's field names.

Requirement: The default encoding shall be `utf-8-sig`.
Acceptance Criteria: UTF-8 files with and without a BOM load correctly.

Requirement: Empty and duplicate header names shall be rejected.
Acceptance Criteria: Validation identifies the bad header and source file.

Requirement: Strict-column mode shall require every record to match the header field count.
Acceptance Criteria: Short and long records report their record number and actual/expected counts.

Requirement: A header-only CSV shall be valid.
Acceptance Criteria: The report shows zero requirements without failing.

Requirement: A named ID column shall be required and matched case-sensitively.
Acceptance Criteria: Missing or differently cased ID column names fail validation.

Requirement: Requirement IDs shall be non-empty after trimming outer whitespace.
Acceptance Criteria: Whitespace-only IDs fail validation.

Requirement: IDs shall be compared as trimmed strings while retaining their displayed source value.
Acceptance Criteria: Rows with equivalent outer ID whitespace match as one requirement.

Requirement: Duplicate IDs within either snapshot shall be rejected.
Acceptance Criteria: The error names the duplicate ID and both CSV record numbers.

Requirement: Changing an ID shall be represented as a removal and an addition.
Acceptance Criteria: No rename inference combines the two rows.

Requirement: Cell comparison shall be exact after CSV decoding by default.
Acceptance Criteria: Case, leading whitespace, and trailing whitespace changes are detected.

Requirement: Line endings shall be normalized to LF before comparison and rendering.
Acceptance Criteria: Equivalent CRLF and LF cell content does not produce a change.

Requirement: An absent schema column shall compare as an empty cell.
Acceptance Criteria: A newly populated column marks matched rows changed; a new empty column does not.

Requirement: Ignored diff columns shall not cause changed row status.
Acceptance Criteria: A row changed only in an ignored column remains unchanged and has no diff highlighting there.

Requirement: Cells shall support paragraphs, line breaks, ordered and unordered lists, emphasis, strong emphasis, inline code, fenced code, safe links, headings, and blockquotes.
Acceptance Criteria: A fixture containing every supported construct renders recognizable semantic HTML.

Requirement: Raw HTML, images, embedded media, nested tables, footnotes, task controls, and extensions shall not be active.
Acceptance Criteria: Unsupported constructs render as inert text or documented fallback content.

Requirement: Link targets shall be limited to HTTP, HTTPS, and mailto schemes.
Acceptance Criteria: JavaScript, data, file, and unknown schemes do not create clickable links.

Requirement: All source text and generated attributes shall be escaped for their HTML context.
Acceptance Criteria: Injection strings cannot add elements, attributes, or scripts.

Requirement: Changed Markdown cells may fall back to escaped source text with diff spans.
Acceptance Criteria: A Markdown change remains safe and its textual change is visible.

Requirement: Rows shall be matched by normalized requirement ID.
Acceptance Criteria: Old and new rows with the same normalized ID form one comparison row.

Requirement: IDs present only in the old CSV shall be classified as removed.
Acceptance Criteria: The row has removed status and old content.

Requirement: IDs present only in the new CSV shall be classified as added.
Acceptance Criteria: The row has added status and new content.

Requirement: Matched IDs with a compared cell difference shall be classified as changed.
Acceptance Criteria: The row has changed status and each differing cell is identified.

Requirement: Matched IDs with no compared cell differences shall be classified as unchanged.
Acceptance Criteria: The row has unchanged status.

Requirement: Diff rows shall primarily follow the new CSV order.
Acceptance Criteria: Added and matched rows occur in new-source order.

Requirement: Removed rows shall appear near a stable former neighbor or at the end.
Acceptance Criteria: Removed-row placement is deterministic and preserves old relative order.

Requirement: Pure row reordering shall not count as a content change.
Acceptance Criteria: A reordered but otherwise identical snapshot has no changed rows.

Requirement: Changed cells shall use line alignment followed by word, whitespace, and punctuation alignment.
Acceptance Criteria: Replaced multiline content shows line blocks and changed word spans.

Requirement: Large changed cells shall fall back to bounded line or whole-cell highlighting.
Acceptance Criteria: A cell over the documented threshold completes without excessive processing.

Requirement: Unified view shall show removed and added fragments in one logical cell.
Acceptance Criteria: Removed and added content uses distinct VS Code-style colors and remains readable.

Requirement: Side-by-side view shall show old and new panes within each changed logical cell.
Acceptance Criteria: Changed cells display labelled Old and New panes.

Requirement: Side-by-side panes shall stack on narrow screens.
Acceptance Criteria: At the mobile breakpoint, panes form one column and retain labels.

Requirement: The report shall switch diff views without reloading or regeneration.
Acceptance Criteria: Toggling preserves filters, sort, comments, and visible rows.

Requirement: The report shall be valid HTML5 with embedded CSS, vanilla JavaScript, and report data.
Acceptance Criteria: Static inspection finds one document and no external runtime dependencies.

Requirement: Embedded report data shall be protected against script termination and Unicode separator injection.
Acceptance Criteria: Adversarial values remain valid JSON and inert HTML.

Requirement: The report shall include a restrictive Content Security Policy compatible with its inline implementation.
Acceptance Criteria: Browser inspection shows no network activity or blocked required feature.

Requirement: The header shall show title, mode, source filenames, generation time, counts, and ignored-column information.
Acceptance Criteria: Each applicable metadata field is visible and absolute paths are absent.

Requirement: Generation shall honor `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` for reproducible output.
Acceptance Criteria: A fixed epoch produces the expected timestamp and byte-stable report for identical inputs.

Requirement: The report shall provide a column chooser with show-all and reset-to-default actions.
Acceptance Criteria: Every column can be hidden, shown, and restored to configured visibility.

Requirement: The report shall provide one literal keyword filter per column and a clear-all action.
Acceptance Criteria: Each filter limits rows and clear-all restores them.

Requirement: Diff reports shall provide status filters, a changes-only shortcut, and a view toggle.
Acceptance Criteria: Each control updates the displayed set or presentation without reload.

Requirement: Column filters shall be case-insensitive literal substring searches combined with logical AND.
Acceptance Criteria: Rows must match every active column query regardless of case.

Requirement: Diff filtering shall search both old and new cell values.
Acceptance Criteria: A query matching only the removed or added side still finds the row.

Requirement: Active filters on hidden columns shall remain effective and be visibly indicated.
Acceptance Criteria: Hiding a filtered column retains the filter and shows a warning.

Requirement: The table header shall remain visible during supported scrolling.
Acceptance Criteria: Header rows stay visible in a current desktop browser.

Requirement: Long content shall wrap and the table shall allow horizontal scrolling.
Acceptance Criteria: Long and many-column fixtures remain readable without tiny text.

Requirement: Clicking a column header shall cycle ascending, descending, and original source order.
Acceptance Criteria: Three successive activations produce the specified order states.

Requirement: Sorting shall be stable, case-insensitive, locale-aware, and numeric-aware.
Acceptance Criteria: Equal keys retain source order and values such as `REQ-2` sort before `REQ-10`.

Requirement: Empty values shall sort after non-empty values in either direction.
Acceptance Criteria: Ascending and descending tests keep empty values at the end.

Requirement: Diff sorting shall use the new value when present and otherwise the old value.
Acceptance Criteria: Removed rows sort by old content and other rows by current content.

Requirement: View state shall not persist across page reloads or saved copies.
Acceptance Criteria: Visibility, filters, sorting, and diff view reset to embedded defaults after reload.

Requirement: Comments shall be enabled by default and configurable off.
Acceptance Criteria: Configured reports respectively show or omit comment controls.

Requirement: Each logical cell shall support multiple comments keyed by requirement ID and original column name.
Acceptance Criteria: Multiple comments survive sort, filter, column visibility, and diff-view changes.

Requirement: Each comment shall store an ID, reviewer initials, creation timestamp, optional modification timestamp, and text.
Acceptance Criteria: Saved embedded data contains all required fields with valid types.

Requirement: Reviewer initials shall contain 1–16 non-control characters and be required to add or save.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid initials block the operation and focus the initials field.

Requirement: Comment timestamps shall use local ISO 8601 time with seconds and UTC offset.
Acceptance Criteria: A new comment timestamp matches the documented shape and local offset.

Requirement: Comment text shall render using the safe Markdown subset.
Acceptance Criteria: Supported formatting displays and unsafe markup remains inert.

Requirement: Reviewers shall be able to add, edit, and delete comments.
Acceptance Criteria: Edits retain creation time and add modification time; deletion requires confirmation.

Requirement: Commented cells shall display a keyboard-accessible indicator and count.
Acceptance Criteria: The control exposes cell context and comment count to assistive technology.

Requirement: The report shall provide an all-comments browser and search.
Acceptance Criteria: Search matches text, initials, ID, column, and timestamps case-insensitively.

Requirement: A reviewer shall be able to navigate from a comment to its logical cell.
Acceptance Criteria: Navigation reveals filtered/hidden content, scrolls to the cell, and moves focus.

Requirement: The comments browser shall show total comment context and a clear empty state.
Acceptance Criteria: Empty and populated fixtures present understandable counts and messages.

Requirement: Saving shall download a new self-contained HTML copy containing the current comment model.
Acceptance Criteria: Reopening the downloaded file displays all comments and works offline.

Requirement: The suggested filename shall be `<base>-reviewed-<initials>.html`.
Acceptance Criteria: Reviewer `PN` saving `system-requirements.html` receives `system-requirements-reviewed-PN.html`.

Requirement: Filename initials shall allow ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores and normalize other runs to hyphens.
Acceptance Criteria: Unsafe characters cannot create paths; an empty normalized token blocks saving.

Requirement: The report shall not claim to overwrite the currently opened HTML file.
Acceptance Criteria: The UI describes a downloaded copy or initiated download only.

Requirement: Any comment add, edit, or delete shall show a persistent unsaved-change indicator.
Acceptance Criteria: The indicator appears after each mutation and clears after download initiation.

Requirement: Unsaved comment changes shall trigger a best-effort `beforeunload` warning.
Acceptance Criteria: Navigating away after a mutation invokes the browser warning where supported.

Requirement: Comment extraction shall parse only the versioned reqtable JSON block and shall not execute report JavaScript.
Acceptance Criteria: Malformed, missing, or unsupported report data fails safely.

Requirement: Snapshot extraction shall reconstruct the original snapshot and append the configured comments column.
Acceptance Criteria: Headers and values match the input plus one comments field.

Requirement: Diff extraction shall default to the new/current snapshot.
Acceptance Criteria: Without `--csv-base`, output row order and values match the new source.

Requirement: Diff extraction shall support old, new, and union CSV bases.
Acceptance Criteria: Each selection emits the expected row set; union adds `_Diff Status`.

Requirement: Extraction shall refuse to omit commented requirements unless explicitly permitted.
Acceptance Criteria: A comment on an excluded removed row causes an actionable error without `--allow-comment-loss`.

Requirement: Extraction shall refuse to overwrite an existing comments-column name.
Acceptance Criteria: A collision fails and instructs the user to choose another name.

Requirement: JSON comment format shall store a per-row array with column, initials, created, modified, and text fields.
Acceptance Criteria: Parsing each populated Comments field reproduces the lossless exported metadata.

Requirement: Text comment format shall emit readable blocks with column, initials, timestamp, and text.
Acceptance Criteria: A reviewer can identify every comment and its target from the CSV field.

Requirement: CSV output shall correctly quote comment commas, quotes, and newlines.
Acceptance Criteria: The standard CSV parser reads exported fields without corruption.

Requirement: The report shall use semantic table markup and associate headers with cells.
Acceptance Criteria: Accessibility inspection identifies a table, column headers, and row headers.

Requirement: All interactive controls shall have visible labels or accessible names and visible keyboard focus.
Acceptance Criteria: Keyboard-only review reaches and identifies every control.

Requirement: Status shall be communicated with text or shape in addition to color.
Acceptance Criteria: Added, removed, changed, and unchanged remain distinguishable without color.

Requirement: Presentation colors shall target WCAG 2.1 AA contrast.
Acceptance Criteria: Automated or manual contrast checks pass for text and controls.

Requirement: The report shall provide a readable print layout that hides non-print controls.
Acceptance Criteria: Print preview contains the report table and omits toolbars and editors.

Requirement: The report shall support light mode and follow browser dark-mode preference.
Acceptance Criteria: Both schemes remain legible and preserve diff meaning.

Requirement: The target workload shall include up to 10,000 requirements, 50 columns, and 10 MiB of decoded CSV content.
Acceptance Criteria: A representative maximum-size generation completes within an agreed UAT time and memory budget.

Requirement: Filtering shall be debounced or otherwise responsive for large tables.
Acceptance Criteria: Typing a filter does not lock the browser for an unreasonable duration.

Requirement: The report shall support up to 10,000 comments subject to browser and file-size limits.
Acceptance Criteria: A large comment fixture remains searchable and saveable.

Requirement: Safety limits shall report errors or explicit fallbacks and shall not silently truncate content.
Acceptance Criteria: Oversized fixtures produce complete output, a documented fallback, or an actionable error.

Requirement: Errors shall be written to standard error and use documented non-zero exit codes.
Acceptance Criteria: Usage/config, input, output, and internal failures return codes 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively.

Requirement: CSV errors shall include filename and record or column context where available.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid fixtures identify the source and location.

Requirement: HTML output shall be written atomically where practical.
Acceptance Criteria: A simulated generation/write failure leaves no partial destination file.

Requirement: Warnings shall identify non-fatal configuration or schema concerns on standard error.
Acceptance Criteria: A warning fixture succeeds while producing a specific warning.

Requirement: The application shall run from source and from a compressed Python zipapp.
Acceptance Criteria: Both entry points produce equivalent reports and exit behavior.

Requirement: The zipapp shall include a `__main__.py` entry point and require no installation.
Acceptance Criteria: `python reqtable.pyz --version` succeeds in a clean environment.

Requirement: The supported runtime shall be Python 3.10 or later.
Acceptance Criteria: CI or UAT covers the minimum supported interpreter.

Requirement: The generator shall use only the Python standard library at runtime.
Acceptance Criteria: Static dependency inspection and clean-environment execution find no third-party imports.

Requirement: CSV, JSON configuration, comments, and commented HTML shall be treated as untrusted input.
Acceptance Criteria: Adversarial test cases do not execute code or alter report structure.

Requirement: The application shall not use `eval`, dynamic script loading, or dynamically compiled JavaScript.
Acceptance Criteria: Static source review finds none of these mechanisms.

Requirement: The report shall make no network requests.
Acceptance Criteria: Browser network inspection remains empty during all interactions.

Requirement: Absolute input paths shall not appear in the generated report by default.
Acceptance Criteria: Only input basenames are present in HTML and embedded metadata.

Requirement: Configuration CSS widths shall be validated against a narrow safe-length allowlist.
Acceptance Criteria: CSS injection attempts fail configuration validation.

Requirement: Comment extraction shall validate report version, IDs, field types, initials, and size limits before CSV output.
Acceptance Criteria: Malformed report fixtures fail without partial output.

Requirement: The project shall include standard-library unit and integration tests for core parsing, diffing, rendering, comments, extraction, security, and packaging.
Acceptance Criteria: The documented test command passes without third-party packages.

Requirement: Integration tests shall cover snapshot, diff, commented-copy extraction, union export, and loss prevention.
Acceptance Criteria: Each end-to-end fixture passes and asserts output semantics.

Requirement: A manual browser checklist shall cover visibility, filtering, sorting, diff views, comments, saving, reopening, keyboard use, narrow layouts, and printing.
Acceptance Criteria: A UAT reviewer can execute every checklist item against supplied fixtures.

Requirement: Column filter fields shall display readable entered text, placeholder text, and caret in light and dark color schemes.
Acceptance Criteria: Text typed into every filter remains visibly distinct from its field background in both supported palettes.

Requirement: A user shall be able to resize a data column by dragging its header divider.
Acceptance Criteria: Dragging a divider changes the width of the column immediately to its left and preserves horizontal scrolling.

Requirement: Double-clicking a header divider shall auto-size the column immediately to its left.
Acceptance Criteria: The resulting width reflects representative visible header and cell content and remains within usable minimum and maximum limits.

Requirement: Snapshot reports shall not repeat the requirement count in a separate summary badge above the toolbar result count.
Acceptance Criteria: A snapshot shows the visible and total count once in the toolbar and uses the recovered vertical space for the table.

Requirement: Hovering or keyboard-focusing a populated comment indicator shall display a nearby read-only comment preview.
Acceptance Criteria: The preview shows reviewer initials, timestamp, and safely rendered comment text without opening the full sidebar.

Requirement: The Columns popup shall close after the user selects Show all or Defaults.
Acceptance Criteria: Each action applies the visibility state and removes the open Columns popup.

Requirement: The Browse comments control shall toggle the comments sidebar open and closed.
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting the control twice returns to the original closed state and updates its expanded accessibility state.

Requirement: Opening a header popup shall close any other open header popup.
Acceptance Criteria: Opening Status while Columns is open closes Columns, and the inverse also applies.

Requirement: Unified diff view shall not render a highlighted empty counterpart when only one side has content.
Acceptance Criteria: Added rows show only green added content and removed rows show only red removed content for one-sided cells.

Requirement: Initial column widths shall be estimated from representative header and cell content without being dominated by outliers.
Acceptance Criteria: Categorical columns start compact, narrative columns receive more space, and one exceptional value does not force an excessive width.

Requirement: Activating a cell comment control shall open a quick-comment popup near that control.
Acceptance Criteria: The popup adds a comment without opening the sidebar and offers an explicit action to open the full comments sidebar for that cell.

Requirement: The report shall support keyboard navigation between table cells and include an offline help page listing every shortcut.
Acceptance Criteria: Arrow, Home, End, Ctrl+Home, Ctrl+End, Page Up, Page Down, Enter or C, slash, question mark, and Escape behave as documented.

Requirement: The selected table cell shall remain visually obvious independently of the browser focus rectangle.
Acceptance Criteria: Mouse or keyboard selection applies a persistent contrasting background and border to exactly one data cell.

Requirement: The table shall support Vim-style keyboard navigation in addition to arrow-key navigation.
Acceptance Criteria: H/J/K/L move left/down/up/right; 0 and dollar move to row edges; G and Shift+G move to the first and last rows as documented.

Requirement: Completing comment editing shall return keyboard focus to the selected table cell.
Acceptance Criteria: After saving a quick or sidebar comment edit, the selected cell is focused, visibly selected, and ready for table navigation.

Requirement: The slash shortcut shall focus and select the filter belonging to the selected cell's column.
Acceptance Criteria: From any visible data column, slash places focus in that column's filter rather than the first table filter.

Requirement: Each column filter shall provide an adjacent clear button.
Acceptance Criteria: The button appears when the filter has content, clears only that filter, refreshes results, and retains filter focus.

Requirement: Down Arrow or Enter from a column filter shall focus the same column in the first matching row.
Acceptance Criteria: Pending filtering is applied before focus moves, and no focus move occurs when no matching row exists.

Requirement: The quick-comment action for opening the full review panel shall be labelled `Show sidebar`.
Acceptance Criteria: Every quick-comment popup displays the concise `Show sidebar` button label.

Requirement: A populated comment-count indicator shall use a distinct color from an unpopulated add-comment `+` control.
Acceptance Criteria: The two states remain distinguishable in light and dark palettes without relying on the numeral alone.

Requirement: Keyboard navigation shall keep the entire selected cell visible within the table scroll viewport.
Acceptance Criteria: Horizontal and vertical scrolling reveal the full cell below the sticky heading and filter rows after every keyboard move.

Requirement: The quick-comment popup shall display at least the most recent existing comment while another comment is added.
Acceptance Criteria: The latest comment shows initials, timestamp, and text; when more exist, the number of earlier comments is summarized.

Requirement: Keyboard navigation shall keep the selected cell to the right of the sticky diff Status column.
Acceptance Criteria: After horizontal scrolling, moving to any cell reveals its full left edge beyond the sticky Status column.

Requirement: Keyboard navigation shall keep the selected cell clear of both edges of the vertical viewport.
Acceptance Criteria: The top and bottom borders remain visible when moving up or down, including beside the horizontal scrollbar.

Requirement: Comment-count indicators shall use red rather than purple.
Acceptance Criteria: Populated indicators render red in light and dark color schemes.

Requirement: A saved reviewed report shall reopen with a clean comment revision.
Acceptance Criteria: The reopened file does not show `Unsaved comments` until a comment is added, edited, or deleted.

Requirement: The toolbar shall show visible columns as a count of total columns.
Acceptance Criteria: The count updates immediately after hiding, showing, or resetting columns.

Requirement: The configured unique-ID column shall not accept comments.
Acceptance Criteria: ID cells expose no add-comment control and comment keyboard actions do nothing on them.

Requirement: Comment timestamps shall be stored as ISO 8601 values with an explicit UTC offset and displayed in local time.
Acceptance Criteria: Stored values resemble `2026-09-13T08:57:19+10:00`; displayed values resemble `2026-09-13 08:57:19` in the browser timezone.

Requirement: An empty blue add-comment control shall appear only for the selected cell or the cell under the pointer.
Acceptance Criteria: Other uncommented cells have no visible add control while populated counts remain visible.

Requirement: Filter placeholder text shall use a paler gray than entered filter text.
Acceptance Criteria: The placeholder is visibly subordinate and remains legible in light and dark modes.

Requirement: The filter row shall be approximately 25 percent shorter than the previous 39-pixel row.
Acceptance Criteria: The row is about 29 pixels high without clipping inputs or clear buttons.

Requirement: Reviewer initials should persist for the current browser user when local-file browser storage is available.
Acceptance Criteria: A later report reuses the initials; when storage is blocked, the embedded report value remains the fallback.

Requirement: The comments sidebar shall be user-resizable and have a compact default width.
Acceptance Criteria: Dragging its left edge resizes it within usable minimum and maximum bounds.

Requirement: A single-cell comment view shall provide a Back action to the browse-comments view.
Acceptance Criteria: Back restores the searchable all-comments list without closing the sidebar.

Requirement: Cancelling or saving a comment edit shall return to the sidebar view from which editing began.
Acceptance Criteria: Browse view remains Browse view and a single-cell view remains on that cell, with its scroll position retained.

Requirement: The comments sidebar shall stay open after navigating to a cell and after adding or editing a comment.
Acceptance Criteria: Each operation updates the table and sidebar without closing the review panel.

Requirement: The slash shortcut shall focus comment search when the browse-comments view is open.
Acceptance Criteria: Pressing `/` from the table focuses and selects the comments search field; otherwise it opens the selected column filter.

Requirement: The table shall provide a Comments only filter that shows only requirements with comments.
Acceptance Criteria: Activating Comments only excludes requirements without comments and exposes its pressed state accessibly.

Requirement: A focused filter for a categorical column with up to fifty distinct non-empty values shall offer exact values as checkboxes.
Acceptance Criteria: Priority, Verification Method, and the 33-value Category column show a scrollable chooser while typed keyword filtering remains available.

Requirement: Saved reviewed filenames shall include a local timestamp suffix by default.
Acceptance Criteria: The suggestion follows `<base>-reviewed-<initials>-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.html`.

Requirement: Opening the sidebar from the quick-comment popup shall focus the comment editor.
Acceptance Criteria: The editor textarea receives focus after the sidebar opens for that cell.

Requirement: Comments shall use deterministic reviewer colors based on initials.
Acceptance Criteria: Different initials receive distinguishable accents and the same initials retain the same accent throughout the report.

Requirement: The quick-comment popup shall permit the active reviewer to edit their latest comment through an action labelled `Edit`.
Acceptance Criteria: The `Edit` action appears only when initials match case-insensitively and updates the existing comment's modification timestamp.

Requirement: The distribution shall document use as a Git difftool.
Acceptance Criteria: Documentation and a wrapper show how to compare two committed CSV snapshots and open the generated HTML report.

Requirement: Clearing an exact-value filter with its `×` control shall restore the normal filter placeholder.
Acceptance Criteria: The selection is cleared, matching rows return, and the input displays `Filter…` rather than a stale selected count.

Requirement: The sidebar Edit action shall update the selected comment rather than create another comment.
Acceptance Criteria: The comment retains its ID and creation timestamp, gains a modification timestamp, and the total comment count does not increase.

Requirement: Existing sidebar comments shall be edited inline within their comment cards.
Acceptance Criteria: The selected card replaces its rendered text with an editor and Save and Cancel controls; no separate edit box appears below the list.

Requirement: Each generated report shall explicitly identify itself as Review mode or Develop mode.
Acceptance Criteria: A prominent mode badge appears in the header and accurately reflects the configured document mode.

Requirement: Review mode shall prevent all requirement field additions edits deletions and ID renames.
Acceptance Criteria: No requirement mutation controls are visible and editing shortcuts or double-clicks cannot mutate requirements.

Requirement: Develop mode shall be explicitly selected using JSON configuration or a CLI override.
Acceptance Criteria: The default is Review mode and --document-mode develop overrides the configured value.

Requirement: Develop mode shall edit non-ID requirement cells inline using their Markdown source.
Acceptance Criteria: Double-click, Enter, or F2 opens a textarea in the cell; Apply renders the new safe Markdown and Cancel preserves the previous value.

Requirement: Ordinary cell editing shall never directly edit the unique ID column.
Acceptance Criteria: Editing gestures on an ID cell leave it unchanged and users must invoke Rename ID.

Requirement: Develop mode shall provide an explicit validated Rename ID operation.
Acceptance Criteria: The operation rejects empty and duplicate IDs and changes the current row ID only after validation.

Requirement: Renaming an ID shall migrate all comments attached to that requirement.
Acceptance Criteria: After renaming the row each prior comment uses the replacement requirement ID and remains browsable.

Requirement: Develop mode shall add a requirement with a unique non-empty ID.
Acceptance Criteria: The new row contains the requested ID and empty values for every other current-schema field.

Requirement: Develop mode shall delete a selected current requirement only after confirmation.
Acceptance Criteria: The current row is removed and a row carrying comments receives a warning that its comments will also be deleted.

Requirement: Requirement edits shall support undo and redo.
Acceptance Criteria: Cell edits additions deletions renames and their comment migrations can be traversed using toolbar controls and documented keyboard shortcuts.

Requirement: Filters and sorting shall operate on the current edited values.
Acceptance Criteria: After applying an edit the row is included excluded or ordered according to its new value.

Requirement: Develop mode shall toggle a diff of changes since the saved baseline.
Acceptance Criteria: The toggle compares the current model with the model at load or at the last report or CSV save.

Requirement: The changes-since-save view shall classify edits additions and deletions using normal diff statuses.
Acceptance Criteria: Edited saved rows are changed new rows are added deleted saved rows are removed and reverted rows are unchanged.

Requirement: The changes-since-save view shall support unified and side-by-side line and word highlighting.
Acceptance Criteria: A changed cell can switch between both presentations without mutating current values.

Requirement: Develop mode shall create a CSV containing the current requirements and omit deleted requirements.
Acceptance Criteria: Exported row order and data match the current in-memory dataset.

Requirement: Develop-mode CSV saving shall include structured comments by default.
Acceptance Criteria: The configured Comments field contains the JSON or text representation for each current requirement.

Requirement: Browser CSV serialization shall preserve delimiters quotes multiline content Unicode and column order.
Acceptance Criteria: The output uses configured delimiters RFC-compatible quoting CRLF records and UTF-8 with a BOM and parses back to the current values.

Requirement: CSV saving shall use a direct file picker when supported and an offline download fallback otherwise.
Acceptance Criteria: Cancelling the picker leaves the baseline unchanged; a successful write or initiated fallback download advances it and reports the appropriate status.

Requirement: The report shall group related report actions by function.
Acceptance Criteria: Open File, Edit, View, Filter, and Columns and verify their actions.

Requirement: The report shall place the modified-cell bar in the left padding.
Acceptance Criteria: Edit a cell and confirm the bar does not overlap text.

Requirement: The report shall provide browser undo and redo shortcuts for Develop changes.
Acceptance Criteria: Use Ctrl/Cmd+Z, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Y outside the textarea.

Requirement: The report shall provide compact green Apply and red Cancel buttons.
Acceptance Criteria: Inspect both buttons and verify their accessible labels.

Requirement: The report shall activate Apply when it has focus and Enter is pressed.
Acceptance Criteria: Tab to Apply and press Enter. Confirm the change is committed.

Requirement: The report shall hide unchanged requirements initially in the saved-baseline comparison.
Acceptance Criteria: Open Changes since save and use Filter to show unchanged rows again.

Requirement: The report shall reuse the current writable CSV destination on Save.
Acceptance Criteria: Save As once, Save again, then confirm Save As can choose a different path.

Requirement: The report shall select a word on double-click and the field on triple-click.
Acceptance Criteria: Perform both gestures inside an open textarea.

Requirement: The report shall store row position independently of requirement ID.
Acceptance Criteria: Rename a requirement and verify CSV row position does not change.

Requirement: The report shall allow relative insertion and manual row movement.
Acceptance Criteria: Add above and below, move a requirement and verify exported order.

Requirement: The report shall provide a permanent blank Develop entry row with automatic ID assignment.
Acceptance Criteria: Cancel one edit, then commit a non-empty value. Verify one new ID and one blank entry row.

Requirement: The report shall support keyboard navigation across menus and their items.
Acceptance Criteria: Exercise Left, Right, Up, Down, Enter and Escape on the menu bar.

Requirement: The report shall autosave committed edits as a recoverable local draft and to the writable CSV when available.
Acceptance Criteria: Recover a draft after reopening. Verify direct autosave after Save As.

Requirement: The report shall render safe Markdown and word highlighting within diff cells.
Acceptance Criteria: Change styled text and verify markup and highlights in both layouts.
